items.title: Louis Jones Interview, 1959-01-19
items.q: Peyton, he used to be an accordion player.

ctx.x: And what kind of music were they playing here then?
Well, they were playing all rag, not particular rag, too many rag music. But they had rag music downtown there, Peyton and them.

items.title: Louis Jones Interview, 1959-01-19
items.q: Carnage player played fiddle, trombone, and accordion.

ctx.x: How big a band did Peyton have? Do you remember how many in his band?
Well, something like string band. String band. Mm. Carnage player played fiddle, trombone, and accordion.
You know, where did he play? Do you remember any of the dances that he gave? Did you ever go to any of his dances?
